changelog: FIX CRITICAL: Vales deletion now properly deletes from Supabase — no more reappearing on refresh or in other browsers.
FIX CRITICAL: adminDeleteVale now works for ALL vales including confirmed/pending_payment (auto-reverts stock).
FIX CRITICAL: cancelVale now deletes from Supabase instead of marking as cancelled (no more ghost vales).
FIX CRITICAL: Race condition — _valesDirectDeleting set prevents _doRestPoll from overwriting deleted vales.
FIX: Gestor vales can now be deleted via admin panel.
FIX: Catalog page (catalogo.html) now loads dynamically from Supabase.
FIX: Admin catalog auto-syncs from Supabase when products are empty.
FIX: Update banner no longer gets stuck — 30-min dismiss cooldown, 5-min applyUpdate cooldown.
FIX: factoryResetVales tracks all deletions to prevent poll race condition.
NEW: PDF generation button in gestor catalog modal and admin catalog panel.
NEW: catalogo.html has PDF download button and loads from Supabase with localStorage caching.
Audit: No remaining Firebase SDK dependencies. db is pure mock.
